crossRefs.note: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me…
Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is Yahweh. Let him do what seems good to him.”
but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you;’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”
He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away.…
I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.
Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
“Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes won’t see all…
These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and…
Yahweh of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy…

people.name: Isaiah
people.line: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

translations.web: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”
translations.bsb: But Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good.” For he thought, “At least there will be peace and security in my lifetime.”
translations.kjv: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
translations.asv: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of Jehovah which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
